name: Central Africa Fibre-Optic Backbone (CAB) CAR Component - National Data Centre / Digital Training Centre (University of Bangui)
developer: Government of Central African Republic / African Development Bank / European Union
notes: AfDB MapAfrica project 46002-P-CF-GB0-002 (A-grade official record) includes a Bangui urban loop with a national datacentre and Digital Training Centre; gouv.cf lists the CAB-CAR fibre backbone as a major in-execution project co-financed by AfDB and EU. Press (journaldufaso, ZMS Cable) describe AfDB-financed works including datacentre/digital-training construction at University of Bangui context. Stage per latest available sources is construction works; no commissioning evidence found, no MW capacity disclosed. Keep grade B overall (A for project inclusion, B for stage/works).

name: GreenLine Technologies / SOCATEL Tier 3 Data Center
developer: GreenLine Technologies Inc. / SOCATEL / Government of Central African Republic
notes: GreenLine official 18 Sep 2025 announcement (A for vendor self-claim): SOCATEL mandate under Casablanca MoU includes a new Tier 3 data center with USD 150M initial investment. Agence Ecofin (2026-07-17) and L'Opinion Plus (2026-07-19) re-verified 2026-08-12 report the operational-phase launch in Bangui on 16 Jul 2026 with Minister Roger Andjalandji and GreenLine's Max Sicari - partnership execution, still not construction. No site address, racks, MW, certification or construction permit found; keep planned until works are named.

name: Huawei Administration Digital Infrastructure / Tier III Government Data Centre
developer: Huawei / Government of Central African Republic
notes: Digital Business Africa (May 2026) and Ecofin report a CAR government partnership with Huawei to modernise public administration digital infrastructure centred on a Tier III national data centre for government data. B-grade lead until Huawei/government/procurement primary corroboration appears; no site address, MW, or procurement status found; keep separate from CAB/PGNSP/GreenLine unless a source links them.

name: Orange Centrafrique Bangui Data Center / Core Network Facility
notes: Trade press reported that Orange Centrafrique's Bangui data center, core network and radio facilities were ravaged by a June 2021 fire and that operations resumed after ~23 days; Orange's Engage for Change CAR page references a local Responsable Data Center role, indicating a continuing local data-centre function. Telecom technical facility, not commercial colocation; capacity_mw null (no public MW).

name: Cybastion Institute of Technology Government Data Centers
developer: Cybastion Institute of Technology / Government of Central African Republic
notes: Cybastion's official release (29 Apr 2021) says CAR Finance/Budget, Economy/Planning/Cooperation and Public Service ministers agreed to a series of government data centers to be constructed by Cybastion Institute of Technology, launched at an April 2021 signing with EU/US diplomatic presence. A for the signing claim; current status unknown/stale - no later verified progress found; Bangui inferred from national-government signing context (noted inference).

name: ECCAS / PIDA PAP2 Central African Republic Data Center
developer: ECCAS / PIDA / Government of Central African Republic
notes: OECD Africa's Development Dynamics 2025 states data centres are a priority in the 2019 ECCAS electronic-communications master plan with a USD 92.5M PIDA PAP2 initiative for six new data centers including one in the Central African Republic. B planning context until the PIDA/ECCAS project fiche is opened; Bangui is the inferred likely national hub (noted inference); keep separate from CAB/GreenLine/Huawei/Cybastion unless linked.
